jobs.title: Team Lead Non-Financial Risk and Internal Controls
jobs.description: N26 is hiring a Team Lead to manage a team of four specialists within Non-Financial Risk Management, owning risk and control assessments, risk appetite frameworks, and enterprise-wide reporting to leadership.
jobs.coverLetterDraft:
Dear N26 Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Team Lead, Non-Financial Risk and Internal Controls role. As Compliance Operations Manager at Pliant, I lead end-to-end KYC due diligence for corporate clients while driving AI-driven automation of compliance workflows as part of an internal AI team — experience that translates directly to designing and maintaining internal control systems and risk appetite frameworks at N26.

Earlier, at Moonfare I co-led an ongoing due-diligence review project and helped shape automation improvements with cross-functional stakeholders, and at J.P. Morgan Chase I conducted due diligence across Corporate, Financial Institution, and Publicly Traded Company risk tiers. Across eight years in KYC, AML, and financial operations, I've built the analytical rigor, escalation management, and stakeholder communication this role demands, plus the four-eyes discipline and quality-review mindset needed to manage a specialist team's output.

I hold a Master's in Finance and Accounting and am progressing toward German B2, and I'm based in Berlin and ready to lead N26's Non-Financial Risk function forward.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

expected: How would you design a Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) framework for a new product line at N26?
Describe a time you managed a team through a high-pressure regulatory audit or examination.
How do you balance risk appetite frameworks with business growth priorities?
Walk us through how you would onboard and mentor a team of four specialists with varying experience levels.
What's your approach to reporting risk metrics to senior leadership in a way that drives action?
How have you used automation or AI to improve compliance or risk workflows in a previous role?
toAsk: How is the Non-Financial Risk team's roadmap currently balanced between regulatory-driven priorities and proactive process improvement?
What does success look like for this Team Lead role in the first six months?
How does the team collaborate with N26's AFC and Banking Compliance functions day to day?
